_v140_note: REVISED 2026-09-21 for v1.4.0. Two groups named cards the merge cut — Alhammarret's Archive in the card-engine group and Lightning Greaves in the protection group — so the 0.733 and 0.597 rates were counting cards that are not in the 99, which silently DEFLATES them. Their replacements are declared in their place: Gleaming Splendor and Greater Auramancy. NOTE ON AURAMANCY: it grants SHROUD, not hexproof, so it protects Heliod from opponents AND from the pilot's own Karametra's Blessing and Guardian of Faith. It is counted as protection because that is what it is, but the handbook's wipe page carries the exception.

_label_corrections.was: A body that can block a FLIER (39 of 53 eliminations came from the air; Kefnet needs seven cards in hand to block)
_label_corrections.why: NEVER A FLYING ATTRIBUTION. The run record holds two separate fields: `eliminated_by {giada-angels: 39, abaddon: 6, baylen-tokens: 8}` — WHO — and `eliminated_how {damage: 53}` — HOW. 39 and 53 were read out of different fields and joined into a claim about evasion. No seat's `eliminated_how` contains anything but `damage`, and the string `flying` appears ZERO times across all four of this deck's sim records. Found by the engine-critic on 2026-09-22 and confirmed independently against the record.
_label_corrections.measurement_unchanged: The label is prose; `any_of` drives the measurement. Verified: re-running the goldfish with this label altered returns byte-identical figures.

_approach_note_2026_11_23: Approach of the Second Sun is the deck's kill (the pilot, 2026-11-23: 'the goldfish for Heliod needs to be built to support the approach of the second sun measurement ... assuming no removal, opponent interaction, how fast do we play approach of the second sun?'). Declared so the turn loop casts it the moment the mana pays, puts the first cast seventh from the top, wins on the second from hand, and tutors fetch it first once cast. Unopposed, like every kill here.
_flash_discount_note_2026_11_23: Heliod, the Warped Eclipse modelled (the pilot, 2026-11-23: 'teach the goldfish Heliod's discount ... allows us to play it at flash after forcing massive draw ... getting Heliod out and tutoring for it are critical ... model it perfectly'). The flip at sorcery speed for {3}{U/P}; then the main phase HOLDS its mana whenever Approach is in hand or reachable this cycle (his choice), and the last opponent's end step is the flash window: find Approach (tutor, Top, Scroll Rack), force each-player draws until it costs only {W}, cast it; after the first cast, Dig Through Time / Scroll Rack / Top bring it back and it wins. Forced Fruition at FRUITION_OPPONENT_SPELLS_PER_TURN (1, authored, his choice). Unopposed.
_treasures_note_2026_11_23: model_treasures switched on, 2026-11-23: Smothering Tithe and Gleaming Splendor were unread on this deck (the pilot asked for 'Tithe's Treasure' in the flash window); the window pays them off each card the opponents draw, Tithe at the authored TITHE_PAY_RATE.
_rhystic_combos_note_2026_11_23: model_discard and model_combos switched on, 2026-11-23 (the pilot: 'teach it Rhystic Study, the Tithe infinites and Medallion'). model_discard is the event channel Rhystic Study and Mystic Remora are read on (OPPONENT_CASTS_PER_TURN, measured from Forge pod logs, taxed at TITHE_PAY_RATE); model_combos ends a game when a Spellbook infinite is assembled with a finisher -- for the two Smothering Tithe lines (Faerie Mastermind + Mirrormade; Gleaming Splendor + Bard) that is Walking Ballista, or Approach found and cast twice off infinite draw and mana.
